requirements.statement: Publish decision per kind is made by one resolver in artifacts library. Default publishes trd, report, design, design-system; every other kind (prd, audit-prd, audit-trd, verification-report, audit-build, check-skill pages, docs-audit, unnamed kinds) records path only. Must pass.
ensemble.publishArtifacts: false turns every publish off, including a run's --publish request; refresh or rebase never reverses it (nor an owner's per-kind object). Must pass.
A run given --publish publishes a kind that is off by default, unless the setting is false.
An object value {kind: true|false} overrides the default for named kinds; unnamed kinds keep the default.
No command or contract reads the old boolean directly; every publish step asks the resolver. Must pass.
Settings template, scaffold-project.sh, command-status.md and guides describe the per-kind setting.
artifacts.js publish --kind K [--requested] [--settings path] prints exactly 'publish: on' or 'publish: off (<reason>)' and exits 0; missing or unreadable settings resolves to the default.

Resolution order: false -> off (even with --requested); --requested -> on; object naming K with boolean -> that value; otherwise PUBLISH_DEFAULTS[K]. true, absent, null or non-object -> defaults alone.

Every publishing command asks the resolver once before its first Artifact call; non-zero exit or missing publish: line is read as off plus one ISSUES line. audit-prd and audit-trd gain opt-in publish; audit-design unchanged.
A design command whose kind resolves off still ends STUCK; its message names the per-kind setting.
On publish: off the record step passes --url "" so a stale stored link is cleared and not republished.
--publish is a standalone flag token stripped from the subject and passed on to chained commands (plan->implement-trd, verify-build->implement-trd --chained, audit-build->implement-trd --reconcile).
scaffold-project.sh keeps setdefault publishArtifacts True; false and an object both survive refresh unchanged.
With shipped true, publish --kind prd prints 'publish: off ...'.
publish --kind trd with a settings file holding false prints 'publish: off (publishArtifacts is false)'.
A refresh over {publishArtifacts: false} and over {publishArtifacts: {prd: true}} leaves each settings file byte-for-byte unchanged.
A grep of packages/core/commands and packages/core/contracts finds no old-boolean read patterns.

tasks.description: Add per-kind resolver to packages/core/lib/artifacts.js (PUBLISH_DEFAULTS, publishDecision, readPublishSetting, CLI verb publish) with Jest tests in artifacts.test.js. Serves O1-O4.

Route every command's publish step through the resolver (create-prd, refine-prd, create-trd, refine-trd, plan, task, verify-build, implement-trd, audit-build, audit-docs, audit-prd, audit-trd); --url "" on off; --publish passthrough in chains; update verify-command-surface.test.js. Serves O1, O2, O3, O5.
Design contract and design commands: replace inline node -e reader with resolver call (--kind design / design-system); keep STUCK for off; update design-commands.test.js. Serves O1, O2, O5.
Settings template and scaffold: keep publishArtifacts true; update scaffold comment; extend BATS tests so refresh keeps false and object byte-identical. Serves O2, O6.

Guard test (publish-switch-prose.test.js) and docs: command-status.md Artifact links rewrite, CONCEPTS, INSTALL, PROCESS, ARCHITECTURE, authoring, design, implement-trd docs, CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Serves O5, O6.
Refresh vendored runtime (.claude/ from packages/core via scaffold-project.sh --refresh); confirm settings still true; run Jest battery and touched BATS files. Serves O5, O6.

open_questions: OQ-1: Should PRDs publish by default? TRD assumes no (off by default; --publish or {"prd": true} turns it on). Owner-only.
